'''FC Komunalnyk Luhansk''' was a professional football team based in [[Luhansk]], [[Ukraine]]. Komunalnyk Luhansk played in the [[Ukrainian Second League]]. It gained professional status in 2007. It played games on Enerhetyk Stadium in [[Severodonetsk]]. After winning the [[Ukrainian Second League|Druha Liha]] B Championship, Komunalnyk Luhansk were promoted to the [[Ukrainian First League|Persha Liha]] for the 2008/09 season.

After competing in thirteen rounds of the competition Komunalnyk Luhansk withdrew from the PFL on October 17, 2008, and lost their professional status."}}
